labels.shortDescription: Error Log context for NPSP household adoption.
Refusal when the user lacks Manage BarnCRM Settings.
labels.value: You need the Manage BarnCRM Settings permission to adopt NPSP households. Ask your BarnCRM admin.

labels.shortDescription: Refusal while household membership is Junction.
labels.value: Household membership is set to membership records, and NPSP households keep their people on each contact's account. Set Household membership to Contact on the General page, then adopt.

labels.shortDescription: Refusal when no NPSP household is left to adopt.
labels.value: There are no NPSP households left to adopt, or none you can see.

labels.shortDescription: Refusal when a run has nothing left to undo.
labels.value: This adoption has nothing left to undo.

labels.shortDescription: Refusal when the count changed. {0} now, {1} confirmed.
labels.value: {0} households match now, not the {1} you confirmed. Refresh the panel and confirm the new number.

labels.shortDescription: Refusal while another adoption or undo runs.
labels.value: An adoption or undo is already running. Wait for it to finish, then try again.

labels.shortDescription: Error Log Info entry after a run. {0} adopted, {1} skipped, {2} refused.
labels.value: NPSP household adoption finished: {0} adopted, {1} skipped because you cannot edit them, {2} refused (each refusal has its own Error Log entry).

labels.shortDescription: Error Log Info entry after an undo. {0} put back, {1} not put back.
labels.value: NPSP household adoption undo finished: {0} put back, {1} not put back (the reason is on each Household Adoption record).

labels.shortDescription: Undo note: the account was deleted.
Undo note: the account is no longer a household.
labels.value: The account is no longer a household, so it was left as it is.

labels.shortDescription: Undo note: the user cannot edit the account.
Undo note: Salesforce refused the save. {0} is its reason.
